summary: A hover tooltip, light or dark, positionable on any side, with an optional arrow.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The trigger's content - an icon, usually. Pair it with `triggerLabel` when there is no text.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The trigger's `aria-label`. An icon-only trigger has no accessible name without it.

props.name: triggerTone
props.description: The trigger's colour. `danger` reads red, for a destructive action.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger the tooltip opens on. It flips automatically if there is no room.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between the trigger and the tooltip, in pixels.

props.name: tone
props.description: `light` is a bordered white card; `dark` is a solid indigo chip with no border.

props.name: arrow
props.description: A pointer notched into the tooltip's edge, aimed back at the trigger. It re-aims itself when `side` changes.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long a hover must rest before it opens, in ms. Set to `0` to open on contact.

props.name: animate
props.description: The tooltip's fade and rise. Turn it off for an instant tooltip, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the trigger's classes, for anything the component leaves unset - a margin, `fs-0` in a flex row. It will not reliably override what the component already sets: which of two utilities wins is decided by the stylesheet's rule order, not by the order you write them.
